The pool's shower bay: a tiled wet room east of the deck, level with the sauna (-0.9) and reached by two 0.3 m steps at the wall-12 passage. The curved screen at the middle shelters three shower positions on the north wall.
[night-route] The night route's exterior: grass ground at y=0, open to the faint-star sky, lit only by the path and doorway lamps.
Finished entry room behind the destination doorway.

walls.comment: Pool doorway west jamb aligns with the stair hall partition east face at x=19.15; the opening no longer exposes the partition end.
Pool/shower divider: a 1.2 m passage at deck height opens onto the two 0.3 m steps up into the shower bay; the step surfaces continue through the wall so the doorway floor is flush with the bay.
Sauna north wall, raised to the shower bay's ceiling so the two rooms seal: it now carries the shower-side sauna door as well as a cedar-clad face.
Continues the corridor's north wall from the existing stub to the Home entrance.

The Home's west wall as one joined slab from the corridor's ceiling line to the gable, carrying the entrance opening the archway cases; it replaces the former three overlapping patches (two wall pieces plus a header) so the envelope is continuous and the header is real geometry, not a coplanar patch.

The Home's south eave wall, parallel to the ridge: it authors the rigid eave height (2.8346-style: y -0.9 + 4.5 = 3.6) so its top is the constant eave plane. Without it the first-match ceiling probe at the west corner picked the corridor's 2.1 m ceiling and left a triangular sky gap above the archway (repaired in job 03).
North knee wall meets the north wall face and north post without an overlapping tail.
South kitchen post meets the knee wall end exactly on the same 26 cm module.
Shower-bay north wall, carrying the three shower risers; its outer face is never seen.
Shower-bay east wall; continues the wall-17 line north past the sauna.
Destination front wall: the centred doorway under a rigid eave-height top.
Destination back wall: a rigid eave height, like the front wall.
West gable wall: its top follows the roof plane to the ridge.
East gable wall: its top follows the roof plane to the ridge.
[home-concept] Working ceramic splash, up to the wall-unit underside.

floor_patches.comment: Ordinary institutional linoleum: the shipped material's waxed default is deliberately overridden down to near-matte here, which is the whole point of the per-surface `shine` override.
Irregular connected spill beside the curtains. Narrow adjoining strips retain the existing tile artwork, sheen and live planar reflections; binary-exact edges avoid dry cracks.
Kitchen tile, ending at the two knee walls; the tile/hardwood transition is the cased opening marked by the threshold below.
The bay's wet zone: the pool deck tile at a raised gloss. Keeping the ordinary tile holds the demo to the pool's single planar mirror instead of adding a second half-resolution reflection pass.
Floor drain under a shower position.

floor_regions.comment: West side of the raised landing: the intermediate step now wraps the landing's west edge, so the deck reaches it from the west as well.
South side of the landing, meeting the west step at the south-west corner: the landing is approachable from the north, the west and the south.
The walkable second floor and balcony: walnut boards 2.6 m above the lower floor, reached by the staircase at its west end.
First 0.3 m step up from the pool deck (-1.5 to -1.2) at the shower-bay passage. Its south edge meets the sauna landing's own region line, so the north approach reads as two 0.3 m risers.

Second 0.3 m step up to the shower bay's own floor (-0.9): its far edge reaches the wall-12 centreline, so the walkable surface is flush through the passage. Its south edge meets the sauna landing's own region line, so the north approach reads as two 0.3 m risers.
Circular hot-tub recess: 30 conservative strips inscribed in the 1.25 m water circle; every step hides behind the shell wall (radius 1.174 m), so no square corner is walkable or visible.
[night-route] The destination doorway's 0.24 m stoop: real raised floor, so the step rule walks it; the porch deck prop dresses this exact footprint.

water.comment: The basin's water: the surface sits 0.15 m below the deck (the deck is at -1.5, the basin floor at -3.0), and the bottom is authored because the deepest floor under the footprint is a real recess, not an accident.

The submerged walk-in step shares the basin's waterline, one volume because the step deck between them is above the surface; its bottom resolves to the step floor at -1.85, so wading here is 0.2 m deep.

The hot tub's water: a disc of radius 1.25 m centred on the tub, so the membership, the colonnade's collision rim (the 30-strip recess) and the drawn surface are the same circle. The surface sits 0.15 m below the deck like the main pool, 1.35 m above the basin floor.

ladders.comment: The basin's chrome ladder at the east rim: the climb volume hugs the prop, from the basin floor to the deck (-1.5), and reaches 0.20 m past the rim so the centre can come over the deck while the climb is still attached. facing_degrees 90 is the +X the swimmer faces while climbing; the deck beyond the rim is the exit.

ceiling_lights.comment: Sauna lamp, moved over the room's centre in front of the benches. Switchable: it contributes a local pool only, so toggling it re-fills just its own layers.
Lights the drying bench and the passage back to the pool.
Warm fill over the sauna's south-west corner: the Home's round flush mount, so the room keeps one sauna panel and one domestic fill.

props.display_name: The Temptation of Adam and Eve
props.comment: Hanging painting on the Home's west wall, facing east. The frame's rear meets the wall at x=53.3; the paired wall decal preserves the photograph's 900 x 546 pixels at High quality. Centre is 1.7 m above the local -0.9 m floor.
Moved onto the utility corridor's south wall so the sauna stands alone; the drum demonstration follows the machine.

The basin's chrome ladder at the east rim: the vertical stock stands 0.23 m off the rim inside the water and the grab rails arch 0.20 m out over the deck, so the mounting reads against the rim and the climb tops out on the real deck.

The corner module of the deck screen: rotated a quarter turn so its long leg runs with the straight module below it and its short leg returns east, exactly like the reference assembly in the Pool showcase fixture.
Kitchen run along the north wall; the counters are the base cabinets' own slabs.

The 0.90 m deck/rim plane is the standable approximation: the 0.40 x 0.31 m basin cannot admit a 0.6 m player disc, so the rim is treated as continuous support, and the faucet post above the deck is decorative and non-blocking.

An upper cabinet 0.55 m above the 0.9 m walkable counter cannot be solid to a 1.8 m player; the base cabinets already block the floor. occludes stays true, so baked lighting and the artwork are unchanged.

Spooner-Man follows a slow six-destination route with seated waits across the pool, offices, laundry, kitchen and balcony. The authored size is the aim/label bound, not collision (the entity is not solid).

The home Spooner-Man. He is a cat: his navigation body is 0.2 m radius and 0.45 m tall, not human-sized. His ordinary AI is an idle predator; when the rat spawns he hears it, pursues it through the baked navigation mesh, and catches it, which starts the pounce/consume sequence below.

Mounted on the west face of the kitchen-opening column, 1.2 m above the floor. E flips the lever (toggle_animation) and toggles this instance's name label in one batch; the lever is a rigid node clip scrubbed toward the opposite end, so a second press mid-move reverses from the current pose and only this instance moves.

The cord's rose meets the gable ceiling at world 4.6733 over the kitchen table, so the orb hangs 0.80 m down with no gap: the level y is 4.6733 + 0.90 (floor) - 0.80 (model height). The owned point light sits 0.02 m below the orb underside.

Hangs from the east corridor's 2.1 m ceiling where the corridor meets the Home wing. The luminous green face owns a small rect light 0.02 m in front of it, so the sign really casts green into the corridor.
Floats in the pool basin 0.4 m off the north rim, beak toward the deck. `y` is only the dry fallback; the float component owns the height: base = surface -1.65 - draft 0.03 + bob.
On the living-room face of the corridor wall, beside the hall door. One press flips the lever and toggles the door; the door has no floating label in v3, so the old label toggle is gone.

The home encounter switch: a wall switch beside the hall door on the living-room face. Pressing it spawns one rat through the ordinary spawn-group lifecycle; a second press while a rat is alive is refused by the group, and the group releases when the rat despawns.

On the sauna side of the doorway, south of the opening, clear of the leaf's swing. One press activates the one intended target: the lever clip plays on the switch itself and the switchable sauna lamp flips. The sauna leaf keeps its own interaction.

The deck's circular hot tub: a joined tiled shell whose 0.13 m bottom flange covers the floor recess's polygon chords, so no square edge is visible. The recess and the circular water volume match its inner radius; the rim stands 0.06 m proud of the deck.

On the sauna's south wall, clear of the door swing and of the light switch. Two mutually exclusive bindings hold the steam on or off: with the emitters enabled the press disables them, with them disabled it enables them, so one press toggles exactly the steam and nothing else. The bound's back plane sits on the wall face (z 14.75..14.85 against the face at 14.85) so the wall can never occlude the aimed ray.

doors.comment: Sauna leaf in the pool-deck doorway (wall 14): wooden stiles, a glass panel and a wooden handle, driven by the shared door system.

volumes.comment: Opens the externally controlled study door as the player approaches from the living room.
Opens it again from the study side, so the room is never sealed.
Stepping into the sauna arms a one-shot 1.5 s timer; the timer starts sauna_warmup on the door, which waits, writes the door's phase and emits the warm cue.

The house's entry band just inside the doorway. Entering it starts the shared wake sequence once; because the binding needs the sequence idle, walking out and back in during the 12 s clip does nothing, and the edge re-arms after exit and completion. The player's own feet are the only trigger.

timers.comment: Headless entity: the timer has no geometry and exists only for the binding above.

sequences.comment: Runs on sauna_door: the door owns the phase state the steps below write, and emit publishes the warm cue for any listener.

Runs on spooner_man_home when the generic `caught` event fires: the pounce clip, a seated consume presentation on the authored sit clips (the rig has no dedicated eat clip), then the rat despawns at the authored completion point and Spooner-Man returns to his idle pose. The caught rat is frozen for the whole presentation by the AI runtime.
Runs on the entry zone: one step starts all three guards' collapse_reassemble clips together, then the sequence holds until the 12 s clip is done so a re-entry cannot interleave.

spawn_templates.comment: The rat: a small navigation body (0.1 m radius, 0.16 m tall) with prey behavior that flees any agent tagged `predator`. It spawns through the ordinary spawn lifecycle and moves through the baked navigation mesh; nothing in the engine names it.
